Definition
[Admissible class, incompressible elasticity] 1. ch8:8.4.4-def-2\group Nonlinear Elasticity \[ \mathcal{A} := \{ \mathbf{w} \in W^{1,q}(U; \R ^3) \mid \mathbf{w} = \mathbf{g} \text{ on } \partial U,\ \det D\mathbf{w} = 1 \text{ a.e.}\} \] for some $q > 3$.
